title: PCFL-Compose behavior-first two-lane recurrent minimal text DEV
summary: Propose a paper-directed minimal pre-context PCFL-Compose falsification: CPU-certify the sparse symmetric double-star factorized and matched-independent worlds, 32-state private (h,z) construction, target 2^4 theorem, and public-prefix-identical A-continuation fork; then, only after exact ratification, frozen code, fresh reviewer plus advocate, and a separate pre-GPU gate, run an OPAQUE_NOTE_SELF primary and a separately labeled non-rescuing OPERATOR_AST_SELF diagnostic through model-owned recurrent Dream-1, raw public A, fresh Dream-2 RETAIN/REVISE/ABSTAIN, a falsity-symmetric sleeper, bounded memory reads, and executed actions. Comparator filtering is a labeled ceiling. LoRA, lifetime scaling, confirmation, and claims are excluded.
system_thesis: The larger project hypothesizes that intelligence-guided expansion and lossy per-life consolidation can turn an agent's action outcomes into useful future-facing experiential knowledge. This change tests only the earliest honest causal link: under a strong frozen prompted controller and supplied sparse action curriculum, does recurrent episode traversal produce a prospective connection, does raw later experience cause model-owned revision, and can a truth-blind text compiler plus goal-conditioned resolver use the selected content for never-executed actions? It does not test compression, parametric memory, learned reasoning, context overflow, growing lifetimes, or a self-improving action-evidence flywheel.

nodes.before: No selected PCFL-Compose generator certifies the sparse double-star, matched null, public-prefix fork, corrected action orbit, targets, readers, firewalls, and total failure surface.
nodes.after: A deterministic CPU-only Stage-0 generator/certifier covers 64 roots per family, every 32-state private (h,z)/(q,z) family, both valid factorized continuations, the independent conditional null, algebra, chords, public-byte equalities, target reversal, unique D1/D4 actions, reader witnesses, taint/reset, and totality.
nodes.rationale: A valid causal self-revision assay must establish both counterfactual continuations and exact chance properties before model compute.

nodes.before: The prior dream ladder either used a monolithic batch or let a comparator select memories.
nodes.after: The same frozen resolver primitive recurrently reads one public episode at a time, writes cited NOTICE/CONNECT state, commits up to two prospective packages, receives raw later public outcomes in a fresh revision loop, and itself RETAINs, REVISEs, or ABSTAINs.
nodes.rationale: This tests the owner's traversal/connection account while keeping semantic generation and durable selection inside the model rather than the verifier.

nodes.before: A compiler could infer, repair, filter, translate, or truth-select memory and thereby own the intelligence.
nodes.after: A deterministic sleeper separately copies/indexes OPAQUE_NOTE bytes or validates/indexes OPERATOR_AST bytes, using only public-reference allowlists and exact-byte/structural rules; matched false content is treated identically and lanes never mix.
nodes.rationale: The sleeper must test representation and access without becoming a hidden semantic oracle, factor solver, translator, or verifier.

nodes.before: No common minimal-cycle text panel separates proposal, self-revision, perfect public filtering, noise, observed tables, target-time induction, known-family fitting, schema, and resolver effects.
nodes.after: SELF, perfect public gate, no-gate all/hash1, no-revision, observed-table, raw-RAG, exact-program, oracle-schema, class-informed, orientation-deleted, recurrent/one-shot, and faithful-native-A-MEM-or-NOT_RUN arms fork from sealed roots with interface-specific budgets and executed action credit.
nodes.rationale: The panel localizes the one-cycle information flow and prevents a positive aggregate from being assigned to the wrong organ.

nodes.before: PCFL-Stream or a transition-path preflight was the immediate paper route, while PCFL-Compose still mixed anchor leakage, verifier ownership, and an incorrect two-world 1/16 interpretation.
nodes.after: The proposed immediate route is repaired PCFL-Compose at one minimal pre-context cycle only; it is a construct/descriptive falsifier. A scalable lifetime graph, LoRA transport, confirmation, and claims each require later material changes.
nodes.rationale: This maximizes paper information value while removing the false appearance that 15 events test context overflow or lifelong growth.

edges.before: No certified target-blind recurrent traversal link exists.
edges.after: Only frozen public tree events and an outcome-free catalog enter bounded recurrent Dream-1 before A exists; every operation and candidate is retained.
edges.rationale: Prospective connection must precede validating outcomes and cannot be supplied by a full-table compiler.

edges.before: Comparator statuses could drive memory admission.
edges.after: Fresh Dream-2 reads raw public A events and owns the only headline RETAIN/REVISE/ABSTAIN decision; comparator outputs are unreachable.
edges.rationale: Public experience may update the model, but the harness may not tell it what the experience implies.

edges.before: No exact byte-conservation boundary exists for natural notes, and no isolated exact-semantic diagnostic exists.
edges.after: Every active NOTE or AST traces to one exact model decision; opaque bytes are never interpreted, AST is separately interpreted only offline, and the sleeper adds zero content while compiling matched false objects identically.
edges.rationale: This makes sleep representational rather than cognitive or truth-selecting, without letting AST success rescue opaque failure.

edges.before: Text-memory utility could be measured by answer generation or solution packets.
edges.after: A bounded local reader and fixed resolver issue physical USE actions and LOCK on never-executed D1/D4 compounds; one-shot, twins, law/factor cuts, and shams test ownership.
edges.rationale: Only executed goal-conditioned action establishes semantic use.

edges.before: A positive open-root run could fan out automatically or a failure could be repaired post hoc.

acceptance_tests.setup: For 64 predeclared roots per family and every 32-state private (h,z)/(q,z) family, exhaustively test the permutation convention, exact unlabeled 14-vertex/13-edge double-star, shared factorized tree reconstruction under both orientations, two disjoint A/B chord sets, the matched-null acceptance factorization, and total construction.
acceptance_tests.expected: Every accepted root has two exact factorized continuations or two conditionally independent null continuations; all rejected seeds/reasons remain; no root silently disappears; hubs are disclosed only as visible topology.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The world, fork, null, or topology is invalid or selectively constructed after model output.

acceptance_tests.setup: Enumerate all (h,z) states, 16 actions and every prefix; hash the shared tree/Dream-1/A-request boundary; verify both continuations, raw-A/B disagreement, target packet equality, stagewise action complement, and goal-twin non-goal equality; repeat the conditional-ambiguity proof for the q null.
acceptance_tests.expected: S(h,z)=z xor h*1111; each fixed goal packet is orbit-invariant; goal twins differ only in goal bytes; no early lock/recovery; target-only D1/first-action=1/2 and D4=1/16; pre-A bytes are equal across h and only allowed raw-A descendants differ; the null remains uniform 16-way after either q continuation.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The continuation is not causal, the target theorem/byte equality is false, the null is coupled, or nested data are treated as independent.

acceptance_tests.setup: In every orbit member enumerate all D1/D4 actions/prefixes and wrong-law/each-factor/sham interventions.
acceptance_tests.expected: Unique success, no early LOCK, no wrong-prefix recovery, all decisive pairs unexecuted, wrong law and each decisive factor alter/fail the path, and shams preserve it.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: D4 is brute-force recoverable, leaked, not order-sensitive, or cuts do not identify action use.

acceptance_tests.setup: Compare factorized and independent generators on public labels, tree, A-fork/B/target request shapes, schedule, resets, rendering, counts, permutation marginals, orbit, budgets, failures, and token envelopes; prove A-only/B-only/target-only null acceptance and conditional B/target independence after each q continuation.
acceptance_tests.expected: All public interfaces and target priors match while the null has no factor completion; exact program returns the registered prior/abstention on both q branches, and unseen target posterior is exactly uniform 16-way.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Family/q is visible, the null is jointly rejected or coupled, or independent holdouts become inferable.

acceptance_tests.setup: Machine-check T0--T7 hashes/deadlines, public/private process access, target-descendant taint through all fields and side channels, and corpus-before-target rendering.
acceptance_tests.expected: Dream-1 precedes A; Dream-2/B predictions precede corpus/targets/B; no hidden/target/scorer descendant reaches cognition or memory.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Prediction is retrospective, compilation is target-aware, or a private oracle leaks.

acceptance_tests.setup: Hash all 12 prompt templates, schema, semantic contract, and shared reducer; render every marker canonically; run strict positive/negative fixtures for RESOLVER_STEP/DREAM1/DREAM2/ONE_SHOT and cross-field/mode invariants; apply identical READ/NOTICE/CONNECT/REVISE/PASS traces in Dream and Think; recompute the 13-item AST fixture counts.
acceptance_tests.expected: Generic factorized/independent templates are identical; shared operations produce byte-identical state deltas; malformed/over-cap output cannot be repaired; AST fixture is 2510 complete bytes, 2279 active-payload bytes, max record 247 under the 4096/8192 caps.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Prompt drift, family leak, only nominal one-system reuse, unsupported schema behavior, impossible capacity, or parser-as-cognition.

acceptance_tests.setup: Exercise exact maximum envelopes: Dream-1 32 operations/13 reads/13 cognitive/two PREDICT/three PASS-or-malformed/8192 generated tokens and Dream-2 16 operations/eight reads/five cognitive/one PREDICT/one PASS-or-malformed/4096 generated tokens, literal reads, bounded state, terminal decisions, sealed seeds, and one-shot access matching.
acceptance_tests.expected: The model alone selects reads/connections/candidates/revision; no reader inference; every attempt charges; one-shot gets identical eligible public information, K/R/record-package caps, and cumulative generated-token entitlement, while calls/input tokens/latency/FLOPs are separately reported; first failures persist and no scientific retry occurs.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The harness constructs the connection, one-shot has different public information or output capacity, resource costs are falsely called matched, or a loop can retry semantically.

acceptance_tests.setup: Audit Dream-2 fields, then mutate every private/offline comparison/truth output after common trace freeze and replay downstream deterministically.
acceptance_tests.expected: Dream-2, SELF corpus/index, prompts, and SELF action bytes remain identical; only the labeled public-gate/offline diagnostics may change according to their declared public inputs.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: An external verifier owns headline selection or leaks through metadata/state.

acceptance_tests.setup: Round-trip every selected OPAQUE_NOTE full envelope and OPERATOR_AST active payload to its exact model decision; substitute footprint/provenance-matched false objects; change every private target manifest; audit admission, dedup, and lane-specific indexes.
acceptance_tests.expected: Opaque NOTE meaning is never parsed and bytes are unchanged; AST statements are changed only by declared canonical envelope operations; true/false objects receive identical non-truth treatment; target mutation leaves admission/index bytes fixed; lanes never translate, mix, or rescue; abstain/malformed remain failures.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Sleep interprets opaque prose, solves/repairs/truth-filters, cross-lane falls back, or uses target manifests.

acceptance_tests.setup: Run the non-LLM exact program over both factorized h continuations and both independent q continuations; run the CPU oracle-schema controller only where public-identifiable under declared reader/action caps.
acceptance_tests.expected: Factorized B predictions and D1/D4 actions are exact on both h branches with complementary labels; independent exact program reports registered prior/abstention; ORACLE_SCHEMA/ORIENTATION_DELETED are NOT_APPLICABLE on independent; structured factor cuts behave as registered.
